text:
Maria Chen: Quick UX question — for the rollout preview that surfaces automatic fallback decisions, how do we show \"why\" a request fell back without dumping raw internal errors? want operator trust but not noise.

Jon Patel: short answer: surface a concise reason category + one sanitized example + link to trace. e.g. reason=latency|error|quota, sample_metric, audit_id. avoid full stack. :+1:

Lee Thompson: yeah + an expand/collapse \"explain\" pane. default collapsed. only show more details if you have the right role. avoids spamming the console.

Ashwin Rao: propose an API field to support that: policy_explain: { reason_code, brief, sample_masked_response, audit_id }. sample_masked_response should redact PII and long stacks. sketch: 

```json
{
  \"policy_explain\": {
    \"reason_code\": \"latency\",
    \"brief\": \"p99 > 1.2s on dedicated-gpu-3\",
    \"sample_masked_response\": \"<output trimmed>...\",
    \"audit_id\": \"ae3f-9b2c\"
  }
}
```

Jon Patel: also include p90/p99 numbers when reason=latency and the candidate model variant that was routed to. small card: \"p99: 1.23s | routed: rdx-medium-quant\". that helps decide quick rollback vs ignore.

deploy-bot: rollout-preview created for policy=contingency-v2 by @Maria Chen — /console/rollouts/preview/ae3f-9b2c :robot_face:

Maria Chen: Nice. UX nit: show whether fallback was automatic vs operator-triggered (icon/color). and when reason=error show sanitized error class (e.g., \"grpc-unavailable\") not stack.

Lee Thompson: agree. also add a toggle \"include sample output\" default OFF. ops can enable for harder investigations.

Ashwin Rao: I'll update the API proto + console mock. plan: add audit_id -> event log linking so we can play back the exact request flow (without dumping secrets). will open a PR with examples and masking rules.

Maria Chen: :thumbsup: can someone review the PR when it's up? would like to land before Friday's ship. @Lee Thompson?

Lee Thompson: I can review in ~30m.

Jon Patel: should we add an opt-in telemetry flag so we can collect anonymized fallback contexts for tuning thresholds? low volume sampling + consent.

Ashwin Rao: yes, will add sampling param to rollout config (sample_rate_pct) and tie to audit retention policy.

Maria Chen: great — thanks team. we'll iterate on the mockups after the PR.
